title: Chemical and Nuclear Reactions
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Chemical vs nuclear comparison analysis using charts and equation models. No radioactive materials or demonstrations are required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for balancing equations, conservation, mole/stoichiometry, and reaction classification
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the atom-building workspace with protons, neutrons, and electrons. Change one particle type at a time: first protons, then neutrons, then electrons. After each change, read the element name, charge, and mass number shown by the simulation. Record a table with protons, neutrons, electrons, element identity, mass number, charge, and the lesson connection for Chemical and Nuclear Reactions.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: OpenStax Chemistry 2e; CK-12; DOE educational resources for nuclear context
